name: agent-task
description: Written with the agent-task form; not approval for agents (that is agent-ready)

name: agent-ready
description: Triaged spec: an agent may take it. Set by a maintainer or the maintenance routine, not a template

name: agent-working
description: An agent has claimed this issue (the claim comment names the branch)

name: agent-pr
description: Pull request opened by an agent

name: self-test
description: Filed by the product self-test routine (issues only)

name: needs-info
description: Waiting for the reporter or a maintainer decision

name: needs-human
description: The agent loop stopped; a person must decide (reason in the last comment)

name: hold
description: A person froze this issue or PR; agents and automation leave it alone

name: risk:T0
description: T0 (docs only). Advisory; the controller labels it, the merge gate recomputes it

name: risk:T1
description: T1 (client, tests, generated). Advisory; the controller labels it, the merge gate recomputes it

name: risk:T2
description: T2 (host/plugin code or unknown). Advisory; the controller labels it, the merge gate recomputes it

name: risk:T3
description: T3 (PASS at the tip, green CI). Advisory; the controller labels it, the merge gate recomputes it
